description: Get list of all cost centers with their IDs and names. Use this to answer questions about what cost centers exist. Rows carry `hidden: true` when the tenant has hidden that cost center in the app (Issue #89) — it still holds bookings and still counts towards company-wide figures, but nobody selects it any more. List hidden cost centers last and say that they are hidden; answer questions about a specific one normally.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization this call runs in (from list_organizations). Required for tools that change data when you belong to more than one organization. Read tools use the active organization when omitted. Does not change the active organization.

name: get_cost_center_list
